concerns.text: FR-014 states that `edge_spectrum.json` must contain fields `model_pairs` and `similarity_matrix`, but `edge_spectrum.schema.yaml` (referenced by FR-013) defines only `model_name`, `top_k`, `edge_vectors`, `checksum`, and `generated_at`. This direct mismatch makes it impossible to satisfy both the functional requirement and the JSON‑schema contract, constituting a contradictory requirement.
